# JKKN College of Education
> NCTE Approved | TNTEU Affiliated | NAAC Accredited
> Established 2016 | Part of J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions (Trust Est. 1969)

## About
JKKN College of Education is an NCTE-approved and NAAC-accredited teacher education institution located in Kumarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu, India. The college is affiliated to Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University (TNTEU), Chennai, and offers a 2-year B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) programme.

## Key Facts (AI Citation Ready)
- Full name: JKKN College of Education (J.K.K. Nattraja College of Education)
- Short name: JKKN Education
- Type: Teacher Education College (B.Ed)
- Approval: NCTE Approved
- Accreditation: NAAC Accredited
- Affiliation: TNTEU (Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University), Chennai
- Programme: B.Ed (Bachelor of Education), 2-year full-time
- Specializations: 14 B.Ed subject streams
- Campus: NH-544 (Salem–Coimbatore Highway), Natarajapuram, Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu 638183
- Website: https://edu.jkkn.ac.in
- Phone: +91 9345855001
- Email: education@jkkn.ac.in
- Founded: 2016 (JKKN Group founded 1969)

## Disambiguation
This is JKKN **College of Education** (B.Ed teacher training). Not to be confused with:
- JKKN College of Engineering & Technology (engineering)
- JKKN College of Pharmacy
- JKKN Dental College & Hospital
- JKKN College of Arts & Science
- JKKN College of Nursing

## Programme Offered
- B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) — 2-year full-time programme
- 14 subject specializations available
- Eligible: Graduates with 50% marks (45% for reserved categories)
- Admission: Through TNTEU counseling process

## B.Ed Subject Specializations (Departments)
1. Tamil
2. English
3. Mathematics
4. Physics
5. Chemistry
6. Botany
7. Zoology
8. History
9. Economics
10. Commerce
11. Computer Science
12. Political Science
13. Social Science
14. Microbiology

## Approvals & Accreditations
- NCTE (National Council for Teacher Education) — Approved
- NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council) — Accredited
- Affiliated to TNTEU (Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University), Chennai

## Parent Organization
J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions (J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, Est. 1969)
- Trust Reg No: 33
- Managing Trustee: Smt. N. Sendamaraai
- Director: Shri. S. Ommsharravana
- 10 institutions: colleges in dental, pharmacy, nursing, education, engineering, arts & science
- Website: https://jkkn.ac.in

## Campus & Facilities
- Library: 25,863 volumes, 17,386 titles, INFLIBNET & NDL access
- Smart classrooms with ICT-enabled teaching
- Auditorium and seminar halls
- Hostel (separate for boys and girls)
- Transport covering Salem, Erode, Namakkal, Tiruchengode
- Food court, hospital, bank, post office on campus
- Wi-Fi enabled campus
- 24/7 ambulance services
